name: Mellow
headline:
Make room for
doing nothing.
copy: Dinner sorted. Weekend planned. Your only job? Enjoy the extra time.
tag: Your time, back in your hands
why: A capybara makes the benefit instantly emotional: less rushing, more living. The clock makes the promise explicit.
favicon: The tall silhouette is charming at 32px; the belly clock becomes a color accent at 16px.
pick: Best expression of getting time back

name: Otto
headline:
Good plans.
Zero paddling.
copy: A little helper for dinners, tickets, and the things you keep meaning to book.
why: The otter treats your time like something precious. A friendly companion for a conversational booking agent.
favicon: The mint face contrasts strongly with teal; whiskers and the clock are secondary at small sizes.

name: Pip
headline:
Plans in a flutter.
Life in full swing.
copy: Tell Pip what sounds good. Get back to your day while the details come together.
tag: A little bird. A lot more freedom.
why: A hummingbird signals speed and lightness. The check-shaped wing connects the personality to getting things done.
favicon: Blue and yellow stay distinct; the wing gives it a recognizable diagonal silhouette.

name: Nimbus
headline:
A lighter way
to make plans.
copy: Hand over the back-and-forth. Keep the excitement of having something to look forward to.
tag: A little less on your mind
why: The cloud turns mental relief into a character. Soft 3D styling suits onboarding, reassuring messages, and completion moments.
favicon: A strong puffy silhouette, especially on dark tabs; the pale edge is subtler on white.

name: Fenn
headline:
A little cleverness.
A lot more living.
copy: Thoughtful plans, quietly handled. From a table for two to your next great night out.
why: A fox brings resourcefulness and taste. The curled tail keeps it friendly, with a more considered hospitality feel.
favicon: Big ears and a cream face are useful recognition cues when the fine texture disappears.

name: Sprig
headline:
More room
to grow.
copy: Let the little tasks take care of themselves. Spend your time on what makes you feel alive.
why: The sprout frames saved time as personal growth. Compact shapes create an approachable everyday companion.
favicon: A compact body and two leaves make a simple icon; leaf separation matters at 16px.

name: Sunday
headline:
A little more
Sunday, every day.
copy: Lovely things to do. None of the planning spiral. Let a little sunshine into your schedule.
tag: Keep the good part of making plans
why: The sun expresses the outcome: free time that feels good. It is a simple, flexible character with a clear shape.
favicon: The circular face and short rays should remain distinctive at the smallest sizes.

name: Tuck
headline:
All tucked away.
All yours to enjoy.
copy: Reservations, little adventures, thoughtful details. A personal concierge with a friendly face.
why: A penguin feels naturally dressed for service. The bow tie adds hospitality while the rounded body keeps things approachable.
favicon: The navy outline and ivory belly hold contrast; the bow tie is a large-format detail.

name: Orbit
headline:
Your plans,
in a happy orbit.
copy: One small companion to keep the details moving, and open up a little more space in your day.
why: The planet suggests an agent coordinating details around you. Its ring is an ownable visual motif across product surfaces.
favicon: The ring adds distinction, though its slim edge needs a check at 16px.

name: Lumi
headline:
Find your
little adventure.
copy: The perfect evening is out there. Let Lumi find the details while you follow the feeling.
why: A moth makes the agent feel like a gentle guide to experiences. It is an unusual, memorable direction for evening discovery.
favicon: Symmetrical wings give a distinctive mark; small antennae are decorative at tab size.
